description: A round bird body with a small feather tuft curling from the top, heavy angled brows meeting over two eyes, and a pointed beak below them; the reference overlaps these facial strokes densely and is hard to read.
A tall pointed hood outline, symmetric about its vertical axis, framing a diamond-shaped face opening, with two flared triangular cloak panels spreading out at the lower left and right.
A wide, horizontally symmetric bat silhouette: two scalloped outstretched wings, a small head with two pointed ears at the top centre, and a pointed notch at the bottom centre.
A front-facing cartoon cat head with two tall pointed ears, spiky whisker tufts jutting from both cheeks, two large upright oval eyes, a small triangular nose and a wide curved smile.
A cartoon boy's head in three-quarter view facing left: a rounded hair cap across the top, thick bushy brows, dot eyes, a small smile, a cheek bulging to the left and an ear on the right.
A dagger on a diagonal from lower-left to upper-right with a long wavy, serpentine blade, a short straight crossguard crossing near its base, and a straight hilt ending in a squared pommel.
A figure seen from the front under a wide-brimmed domed hat with two eyes on the crown, a heart-shaped mark below the brim, and two arms reaching down at the sides; the reference is hard to read.
A cloud centred at the top joined by a short vertical link to a gamepad below, the gamepad with a rounded body, two splayed grips and no visible buttons.
A wide rectangular arcade control base on two short feet, with a ball-topped joystick rising on a thin shaft from its left half and a low rectangular button block on the right of its top edge.
An arcade stick: a long shallow tray-like base with a raised inner rim, a tall ball-topped joystick on a thin shaft at centre-left, and a small rounded button on the right of the top surface.
Four equal open rings arranged in a diamond — top, left, right and bottom — like a gamepad's face-button cluster, with even gaps between them.
A plus-shaped directional pad with four rounded arms of equal length meeting at a small square centre, each arm slightly pinched where it joins the middle.

A bow drawn as a quarter-circle arc whose ends are joined by two straight string lines meeting at the lower left, with an arrow crossing diagonally from its fletched lower-left tail to a pointed tip past the upper right.
